articles.title: Three men found guilty of murdering two Australian surfer brothers and US friend - BBC
articles.description: The bodies of Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were found  at the bottom of a well.
articles.content: The men's full names could not be given for legal reasons, and they were only identified as Jesús Gerardo, Irineo Francisco and Ángel Jesús. They are yet to be sentenced - but are likely to spend the… [+32 chars]
